message.content:
I’m not sure which university you’re interested in or what kind of “class” you’re looking for (e.g., undergraduate course, postgraduate seminar, workshop, etc.).  

In general, most universities in Sydney run a mid‑year term that starts in late April or early May and runs through June. For example:

| University | Typical May Term Dates | Notes |
|------------|------------------------|-------|
| University of Sydney | Late April – early July | Mid‑year term (Term 2) |
| UNSW Sydney | Late April – early July | Mid‑year term (Term 2) |
| Macquarie University | Late April – early July | Mid‑year term (Term 2) |
| SFSU (Sydney) | Late April – early July | Mid‑year term (Term 2) |

If you let me know:

1. **Which university** you’re interested in (or if you’re open to any),
2. **What level** of class (undergrad, postgrad, professional development, etc.),
3. **Any specific subject area**,

I can give you more precise information or point you to the right course catalogue.
